text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of Lucky Lilac's debut race.

text_block_list.name: Hardcore Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
âDid you hear?
Lucky Lilac's making her debut today.
Word is even that "Tyrant" acknowledges her.

text_block_list.name: Hardcore Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! People were talking about that.
Something about running one-on-one together...
Does that mean you're, like, her apprentice...?

text_block_list.name: Hardcore Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Orfe's debut was at Niigata too, right?
This has gotta be totally intentional!

text_block_list.name: Hardcore Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"If she really is your apprentice, I can't wait!
I wonder how she runs...!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Horseshoes, check. Leg condition, check.
Hood, check."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Everything's in order.
Looks like we're ready to go anytime."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I'm getting soooooo nervous――!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Is this what race day really feels like?
Freezing up from nerves right from the get-go...
That's way too uncool...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(No, wait! Times like these are what Trainers are for!
I'm sure they'll have the perfect witty comment ready!
I'm countin' on ya~!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It's almost post time.
I must give Lucky Lilac some encouraging words!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Wait, you're nervous too?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ......Well, that's about the size of it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, ya seemed so calm and collected
right when ya got to the waiting room,
so I figured I oughta pull myself together, too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: And yet, once we opened the lid... heheh—
choice_data_list: Sorry you had to see me in such a pathetic state.
Sorry you had to see me in such a pathetic state.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all. If anything, it made me feel relieved.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Besides, once I got a quip in,
all my nervousness just up and vanished.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll show you the running I've forged.
Please watch over me."
choice_data_list: Let's make this the best debut race ever!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Well, I'm off then.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I'm lookin' forward to workin' with ya today.

text_block_list.name: Hardcore Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh...! Lucky Lilac
is looking so calm and composed. What a presence~."

text_block_list.name: Hardcore Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
She might really turn out to be a superstar...!
I can't wait for the race~!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky Lilac,
will blossom here in Niigata—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, watch this, Niigata~~!!!
My stardom road starts right here, right now, ya hear?!!!)
